description: Source code for the backend worker component of a logging system, managing thread creation, priority setting, log processing, and queue handling.

classes.name: backend_worker
classes.description: Class managing a worker thread for processing log entries, including thread control, priority setting, and queue processing.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Signals the worker thread to stop and joins it if joinable.

methods.name: set_thread_priority
methods.description: Sets the thread priority based on the specified backend_priority enum.

methods.name: create_worker
methods.description: Creates and starts the worker thread with the specified priority.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Ensures the worker thread is created once and starts it.

methods.name: do_work
methods.description: Main loop for processing log entries from the queue, handling full queue errors, and terminating gracefully.

methods.name: process_log_entry
methods.description: Processes individual log entries, handling flush commands and writing log data.

methods.name: process_outstanding_entries
methods.description: Processes remaining log entries after thread termination.
